scope: Reviewed source-level Rust provider/context/output boundaries; static inventory freshness only, not exhaustive dynamic mediation or production qualification.

flows.material: instructions, document text, path/digest metadata
flows.current_controls: contained paths, secret-pattern rejection and freshness are independent of BLP
flows.required_observable: read exact labelled source under current authority; substituted/unknown source refuses before prompt exposure

flows.producer: method catalogue/local source with missing-only bundled fallback
flows.material: complete method text and workflow instructions
flows.current_controls: NOFOLLOW descriptor walk, caps and strict missing-only fallback; no classification attribution
flows.required_observable: classify local and bundled versions independently; changes invalidate the exposed domain

flows.consumer: preparation retained sources and source HTTP response
flows.material: full-file digest, selected lines and retained text
flows.current_controls: current full-file hash and saved source policy; pattern filters do not establish confidentiality
flows.required_observable: bind full source version and excerpt lineage; unauthorized reader receives no excerpt

flows.material: questions, model answers and omitted-turn metadata
flows.current_controls: native history checks, prompt redacted from DTO; recent mode does not declassify prior received data
flows.required_observable: carry classifications for every reused turn; a smaller history is not a lower domain

flows.producer: documents, adopted brief, methods, project, history, user message
flows.consumer: private preparation_turns row then worker claim
flows.material: complete combined prompt and private native envelope
flows.current_controls: Root/settings/SQL snapshots, digests/revisions/caps and budget admission; native v3 provenance verifies every prompt byte before worker use. Authenticated readonly blp-preparation-check resolves current control attributions of every exact slice and joins them under the diagnostic caller clearance. It grants no send authority, original-sender binding, producer source labels or fixed transmission domain. Explicit persisted preparation_quarantine blocks admission/claim and controlled API/CLI egress. A dedicated shared egress reservation serializes config/BLP mutations through actual IO while releasing the business Trust reservation. Absent/false retains legacy behavior; no classified destination/sender authorization, descendant confinement or output inheritance is established. Authenticated cleared I3/admin blp-preparation-attribute now derives an exact selected slice digest/path from the actual captured native turn, validating complete provenance, Root instance, source_revision and parent before delegating to canonical attribution; caller digest/path fields refuse. This is post-capture control attribution, not an admission principal or persisted fixed domain. Separate authenticated pre-transport admission now reuses the exact legacy producer without SQL turn/reservation or provider IO; cleared I3/admin explicitly attributes captured input slices, then actual admitting principal must dominate the join of every current source. Create-only private native-framed capsule freezes prompt/provenance/principal/policy/Root; owner metadata reads and replay revalidate current authority, and policy changes never refresh it implicitly. No capsule is executable or enumerated by legacy turn readers; allowed recipient/transport/output inheritance and upstream transformation-wide label inheritance remain open. The explicit destination binding records an administrator label for the exact api- account/endpoint digest; the last-use blp-preparation-transport decision re-verifies the capsule, freshness, current binding and no-write-down under the shared egress lock without emitting, reserving or mutating.
flows.required_observable: protected producer attributes each source and fixed combined domain, including instructions and user text

flows.producer: registered CLI worker and saved prompt
flows.material: full prompt, selected environment, account configuration
flows.current_controls: fresh private gate and mandatory I0 sandbox; provider identity is not clearance Explicit persisted preparation_quarantine blocks admission/claim and controlled API/CLI egress. A dedicated shared egress reservation serializes config/BLP mutations through actual IO while releasing the business Trust reservation. Absent/false retains legacy behavior; no classified destination/sender authorization, descendant confinement or output inheritance is established.
flows.required_observable: current clearance and destination policy checked before exec; descendants cannot use alternative output

flows.material: serialized prompt, model identifier and bearer key
flows.current_controls: saved deadline/cancellation, redirects/retries disabled; no classified-send BLP engagement reservation Explicit persisted preparation_quarantine blocks admission/claim and controlled API/CLI egress. A dedicated shared egress reservation serializes config/BLP mutations through actual IO while releasing the business Trust reservation. Absent/false retains legacy behavior; no classified destination/sender authorization, descendant confinement or output inheritance is established. The controlled last-use decision path (CLI/HTTP readonly) is typemapped 400/404/409/403/500 and publishes nothing; it still does not engage the real send, which remains legacy/quarantined. BF-07 hook delivered: the Api worker calls preparation_worker_transport_gate inside its egress reservation before building the request — zero matching admission receipts keeps the legacy path, >=1 triggers full re-verification, destination attribution, mandatory base_url/model echo and last-use no-write-down; fail-closed receipt scan, turn custody required; no socket without a decision. Still no result inheritance, OS confinement or production activation.
flows.required_observable: bind exact serialized bytes, effective endpoint/account/proxy path and current policy before first byte

flows.producer: fixed probe text and draft effective key/destination
flows.material: fixed protocol text plus credential/model/network metadata
flows.current_controls: explicit manual probe, draft/current key-destination checks; not project context
flows.required_observable: classify credential use separately from fixed text; deny unauthorized destination without credential transmission

flows.producer: current Work contract and prepared agent prompt
flows.material: task/supervisor contract, instructions and project material
flows.current_controls: scope/freshness/owned workspace and current launch authority; no authenticated BLP domain
flows.required_observable: record complete exposed sources and current instance clearance before private gate consumption

flows.producer: planning current material and method context
flows.material: planning prompt and policy/decision context
flows.current_controls: owned claim/lease and private gate; tool-free arguments alone are not isolation
flows.required_observable: same source/destination checks as worker, including retries and supervisor outputs

flows.material: candidate, review attachments and exact prompt
flows.current_controls: candidate/source rechecks and private gate; no BLP source admission
flows.required_observable: independent review context may receive only authorized source classifications; keep review independence

flows.material: command argv/environment, workspace file reads and tool outputs
flows.current_controls: current committed slot, managed I0 workspace, environment allowlist and mandatory Biba profile
flows.required_observable: classify argv/env/workspace and outputs; external tool reads/egress cannot bypass domain

flows.material: sealed stdin, argv, environment and inherited descriptors
flows.current_controls: exact execve, pinned workspace, CLOEXEC and I0 profile; not general secrecy boundary
flows.required_observable: consume a current protected exposure authorization; no raw prompt can bypass the producer path

flows.consumer: host readable leaves and network services
flows.material: files, caches, SDK sessions, sockets and descendant channels
flows.current_controls: Biba excludes private authority, limits writes and denies AF_UNIX; BF-14a (2026-11-09): the engine poses an additive seccomp refusal of AF_INET/AF_INET6 socket and socketpair (EPERM) for classified provider helpers at all five transport exec points (agent gate, planning, reviewer, preparation CLI, task validation), decided by the explicit persisted operator policy provider_internet_denied read under each gate's own Trust reservation and frozen at exec — kernel-level OS evidence shows the mandatory profile alone still allowed INET creation (BF-14 gap), the additive filter denies it uniformly while preserving AF_UNIX verdicts (badged recipe biba-linux-boundary, native-internet case)
flows.required_observable: close actual read/egress paths with positive control and receiver-side canary observation

flows.consumer: local ingest service, storage and UI readers
flows.material: usage, logs/traces/metrics, per-attempt ingest token and metadata
flows.current_controls: opt-in saved provider policy, token-bound ingest, prompt logging disabled in Codex recipe; BLP domain still unbound
flows.required_observable: bind actual exporter destination/reader to domain, including error and trace values

flows.material: returned text, proposals and provider-declared usage
flows.current_controls: response parsing/limits/state/publication and explicit operator adoption; BF-16a (2026-11-05): the public dialogue read applies no-read-down on readers when an admission receipt matches the turn (scan-then-decide, four typed blp-dialogue-* refusals, zero bytes on refusal); BF-16b (2026-11-06): the same shared reader verdict covers preparation_show, preparation_history and release-review (adopted documents linked by source_turn inherit their source turn's domain; zero matched receipts keeps the legacy bare read); BF-16c (2026-11-08): the send frontier (replayed turns and first admission inside the write transaction) and the stop frontier (terminal-turn serving, legacy and native rows) decide the same shared reader verdict before any recorded answer byte is served; refusals roll the whole send admission back (no turn row, no budget reservation, no byte); producer-internal settle passes None as the explicit producer exemption; no BLP classification is persisted on answers or proposals and no context-domain inheritance is established BF-16d (2026-11-08): the command frontier (preparation_command — use-proposal adoption and receipt replay, verdict inside the Immediate transaction before commit so a refusal rolls back document, revision and receipt) and the list frontier (preparation_list, per-row like show, whole-list refusal on the first insufficient reader) decide the same shared reader verdict; budget views stay counter-only and out of scope
flows.required_observable: result inherits exposed context domain even if short/empty; subsequent memory/use keeps restrictions

flows.consumer: log API, console and explicit CLI output file
flows.material: messages, tool results, errors and transcript metadata
flows.current_controls: saved capture limits, typed errors and session admission; not per-reader BLP
flows.required_observable: authorized reader/export only; identify silent leakage in error, metadata and truncated output paths

flows.consumer: history reader and future recovered context
flows.material: historical messages, evidence, memory references and replay state
flows.current_controls: stored provenance/row identity and read isolation; not current BLP permission
flows.required_observable: migrate unclassified retained data explicitly; old grant/replay never bypasses current reader clearance

flows.material: supplied labels, canonical action, hashes and reports
flows.current_controls: strict data contracts and independent exact hashes; fields confer no authority
flows.required_observable: protected adapter resolves source labels from authority, never trusts labels deserialized from user JSON

flows.consumer: service staging/object database before ref publication
flows.material: Git objects/pack bytes, private staging files and receipts
flows.current_controls: retained source/destination/Root descriptors and separate permission; no BLP write-down check
flows.required_observable: authorize destination before exporting/importing pack; lower-classified copy requires exact human declassification

flows.material: ref metadata, candidate objects, action and receipts
flows.current_controls: OLD fencing, exact current agreement and idempotence; publishing is not declassification authority
flows.required_observable: preserve existing effect guards plus destination confidentiality; revocation precedes any new disclosure

flows.consumer: separate SQLite ledger and output consumer
flows.material: invoice/account metadata, canonical context and recorded/replayed receipt
flows.current_controls: held account/permission/SQL uniqueness and known-uncertain outcomes; no BLP source/reader binding
flows.required_observable: classify ledger/context/receipt and consumers; reconciliation does not authorize broader disclosure

flows.consumer: native UI reader and prepared approval request
flows.material: full proposal/context, exact terms, approver metadata and credential use
flows.current_controls: session/Host/CSRF, exact prepared action and approval channel; preview and approval presentation re-read current Trust identity, BLP policy and digest/project attribution before projection; attribution renewal cannot lower prior level/compartments. BF-23c (2026-11-08): the Admin dialog offers the explicit per-object attribution form (BLP-03): 64-hex digest, absolute project path, level/compartments chosen from the re-read policy (never invented by the page), non-empty reason; preview then apply replaying the exact previewed event bytes; apply disabled until preview passes; session-alone and weak-bearer refusals stay typed 403 without mutation; no unclassified-object enumeration or bulk scan. No human declassification or general source mediation.
flows.required_observable: reader clearance before preview, then authenticated specific declassification of exact copy/destination if required

flows.consumer: operator show/export, verifier report and retained archives
flows.material: originals, policy history, identifiers, proofs and diagnostics
flows.current_controls: operator authority, hashes/publication errors; connected PAEA readers validate current persisted attribution and monotone history. Diagnostics remain non-authorizing; remaining show/export/archive surfaces need BLP coverage. Security metadata is an I3/admin read-only observation of current BLP capability and compiled declared inventory, with no project bytes, grants or evidence import; NOT_TESTED/unknown/not_qualified remain explicit. It does not verify source-anchor freshness or classify/export project evidence.
flows.required_observable: protect evidence contents/readers and report leaks; external acceptance and history integrity remain separate

flows.producer: recorded native prompt parts and current protected control attributions
flows.consumer: authenticated CLI stdout or protected HTTP response
flows.material: joined classification, authenticated diagnostic actor, policy revision, prompt digest and part count; no prompt text
flows.current_controls: current Trust reservation/authentication/grant and BLP revision; physical Root/parent/provenance checks; every exact slice attributed, no default; conservative join/read clearance; typed HTTP refusals and explicit read-only rollback/close; runtime_authorized=false
flows.required_observable: bind physical producer source identities and actual response recipient/output medium; do not reuse this observation as a dispatch ticket or persisted provider-result label

exclusions: No provider/account call, live mission or secret file read.
Historical Go source is not a delivered Rust flow.
Host administrator, privileged kernel attacker, covert channels and arbitrary outside same-UID writers remain outside this application inventory.
Unsupported import/restore/protocol branches are not made available by inventory.
remaining_evidence: Actual classified source producer and migration binding to authenticated current authority.
All dynamic SDK/tool/cache/proxy/descendant channels need runtime observation and explicit deny coverage.
Public positive paths and refusal/recovery on exact shipped profile; every OPEN row remains a qualification gap.
